manifest.source: torchvision datasets (MD5-verified archives), ResNet-18 ImageNet embeddings; attacks applied to raw pixels
manifest.policy: Tune only on dev datasets; the test datasets are the headline. Never edit this file in place: create a new benchmark_id for any change. Real human-noise results (CIFAR-10N) live in bench_realnoise and are reported separately from injected-attack results. v2 adds pixel features and the veritas_mm detector; the dataset split and attacks are unchanged from v1. v3 changes only the veritas_mm pixel gate (3 -> 1, chosen on dev: results/ gate study in docs) and scores veritas2 and veritas_mm on the test datasets. v4: veritas_mm gains shared-pattern checks (dup, cell, resid) and extrapolated row scores, chosen on dev; 12 clean batches per seed for a firmer false-alarm estimate. v5: same data and attacks as v4; adds per-check detectors (mm_label ... mm_resid, raw evidence) and mm_lead for a per-check report; 24 clean batches per seed (240 clean test batches).
